status: provisioned: bucket, runtime role and instance profile (role not yet attached to an instance)

provisioned.source: AK decision 2026-10-15; created by the account root; read back with the AWS CLI (S10f #2759)

runtime_role_policy.name: tw-server2-runtime-s3
runtime_role_policy.not_granted: DeleteObject, other prefixes, other buckets, bucket administration

host_candidate.cache_capacity_scope: dedicated root managed raw and temporary allocated bytes across all namespaces; current namespace eviction, insufficient space skips disk fill; same cap for shared processes
host_candidate.cache_truth: S3; loss/corruption/full disk are safe misses; mutable catalog/state/budget/push/geocode excluded

runtime.measurement_gate: S09 real host RSS/CPU, musl startup, cold p50/p95/p99, S3 throughput, interruption and budget demand

provider_keys.source: server2/.env, a private copy of the legacy server/.env (AK decision 2026-10-15, S10e #2753); the server2-only values SERVER2_S3_BUCKET and SERVER2_S3_REGION are added there; optional disposable cache directory/cap are server2-only operational values
provider_keys.quota_units: data.go.kr calls; VC records; geocoder chain calls
provider_keys.s3_credentials: EC2 instance role tw-server2-runtime through IMDSv2 when AWS_ACCESS_KEY/AWS_SECRET_KEY are unset or the legacy placeholder (S10f #2759); real static keys only when the operator sets both

network.public_ingress: existing origin routing only after approved family gates
network.s3: same-region TLS endpoint; evaluate gateway endpoint cost with network plan
network.providers: explicit provider hosts only; no unrestricted test fallback

readiness.future_gate: S3 read/auth test, required config/keys, family switch, budget admission, bounded cold warm-up

missing_key_iam_validation.status: operator-user statuses observed 2026-10-15 (S10f); the runtime-role check remains for the EC2 deployment
missing_key_iam_validation.risk: Prefix-conditioned ListBucket may not establish missing-key 404 semantics for HEAD/GET; local peer 404 is not IAM evidence.
missing_key_iam_validation.required_check: With actual runtime role HEAD and GET known-absent raw/v2 and index/v2 keys: require 404/NoSuchKey; separately require 403 on unauthorized reads.
missing_key_iam_validation.evidence: Sanitized statuses, role/policy revision, region and timestamp; no secrets. Operator-user run: docs/evidence/aws/server2-s3-readiness-2026-10-15.json
missing_key_iam_validation.failure: Block readiness and review policy/error classification; never infer absence from 403 or automatically widen permissions.
missing_key_iam_validation.tool: server2/tools/s3_readiness.rs: from server2/, cargo run --locked --release --example s3_readiness -- LABEL; with the instance role it also requires 403 outside the server2 prefixes

drain.trigger: IMDSv2 interruption/rebalance or operator signal, monitoring separately authorized
steps: finish already owned raw/group publication within bounded time
do not resend failed or unknown push delivery
send SIGTERM and preserve sanitized outcome logs
drain.unexpected_loss: acknowledged state/records must already be S3 durable; drain is not durability guarantee

rollback.retirement_contract: AK later instruction: no legacy dependency or precollection after go-live; S20 must verify request-time acquisition and partial missing-data/error behavior

scale_out: plan only: independent caches, S3 CAS/reservations/fetch/capture ownership and bounded warm-up; no shared cache
